subject: Security discovery — log retention, backups, erase window (post-demo)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: security discovery recap & immediate asks

Hi Sara / ClearWell security team,

Thanks again for the demo time today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our side and three asks to keep momentum:

Summary of what we discussed:
- SOC 2 status & evidence timeline
- GDPR/HIPAA scoping for customer PII and business associate processing
- Log retention policy: default retention, backups & snapshot TTL, and erase/restore workflow

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Can you confirm whether you need a SOC 2 Type II report at contract signature or if a SOC 2 Type I + remediation plan is acceptable for now? (We can share redacted Type II artifacts where available.)
2) Please confirm the required retention window for logs & backups for this pilot: you mentioned 90 days for access logs and 1 year for backups — please confirm for each class (audit logs, application logs, KV cache snapshots, backups).
3) Can you share any vendor security questionnaire you want us to start filling out? If you prefer, we can initiate the vendor form and send a DocuSign link for signatures.

Attachments: redwood-security-brief.pdf (brief overview + retention/backup options)

Proposed follow-up: 30-minute technical sync next week to align on retention SLAs and evidence items.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

--
Redwood Inference — inference runtime for production LLMs
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@clearwellhealth.com, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security discovery recap & immediate asks

Thanks Ava — good meeting. High-level answers below and a policy doc attached.

SOC 2: We are currently in the middle of our Type II audit (window closes Q3 2027). For procurement we accept a recent Type I plus the SOC audit plan and a remediation timeline. Ideally we would like Type II evidence before full production cutover but pilot/POC can proceed with contractual milestones.

Retention / backups (initial):
- Audit & access logs: default 90 days (we may require extended retention for certain regulated workloads)
- Application logs: 90 days
- Backups (snapshots): retained for 365 days by policy; cold storage beyond 1 year requires a business case
- Erase window for customer PII: we expect vendor support for removal/verification within 30 calendar days of request; full immutable backups may have separate retention clauses and require targeted wipe/retention exception processes

Attached: clearwell_infosec_snapshot_policy.pdf (snapshot retention + restore tests)

Vendor questionnaire: please send over the Redwood intake form. We will also send our vendor security questionnaire for you to complete (we prefer PDF/DocuSign).

Tom from InfoSec will join for the follow-up. Proposed time: Thu 20 May 10:00am PT.

-Sara
Sara Kim
Director, InfoSec | ClearWell Health
sara.kim@clearwellhealth.com
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security discovery recap & immediate asks

Ava / Ben — drafting a response pack for ClearWell. Notes and recommended replies below (we should send before Thu sync):

1) SOC 2: we can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II artifact for other customers now; for ClearWell we can provide Type I + current audit plan and expected Type II completion date. Add a note about our continuous controls monitoring and our SOC audit co-operation workflow.

2) Retention options & technical feasibility:
- Audit & application logs: default 90 days. We support configurable TTLs up to 3 years for Dedicated/Private deployments. For Hosted customers we can provision extended retention (90/180/365) depending on retention storage tier — will impact cost.
- Backups/snapshots: standard 365-day retention in cold storage; we can configure longer retention for Dedicated customers. For erase requests that impact backups, we support targeted logical deletes and proof-of-deletion reports (subject to restoration windows and backup immutability constraints).

3) Erase window: 30 days is reasonable. Operationally we provide a verification report and can coordinate with customer on timing for backup restores & targeted scrub. If customer requires deletion from immutable snapshots older than retention cutoff, we need an exception process and legal review.

4) Vendor questionnaire: let's pre-fill the sections we control and ask ClearWell to share their PDF; I will prepare the technical appendix (logs/backups/retention matrix) and attach.

Action items (internal):
- Ava: send a one-pager summarizing the retention bands & cost delta for 90/180/365-day retention.
- Ben: prep a short evidence bundle (controls summary + sample redacted artifact).
- Dev: draft the technical appendix and walk Tom through the restore/delete mechanics on the sync.

Attachment: retention-options-summary.md

—Dev
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
